job.title: Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software
job.pay_full: $143,700 – $194,400 a year base salary (Austin, TX), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network, built to bring fast, reliable internet to households, schools, hospitals, businesses and government agencies beyond the reach of existing networks. The Leo Customer Terminal Software team writes the software, both applications and the underlying Linux system, for the devices that connect customers to the network, working with hardware, product and operations teams.
duties: Develop embedded software for Customer Terminal devices in the Leo system
Work across the whole development cycle: requirements, design, code, test and code/test coverage
Write embedded software in C, C++, Rust, Python or other languages
Apply real-time embedded practices and Linux and/or RTOS expertise
Review schematics and troubleshoot with logic analyzers and embedded debugging techniques
needs: 3+ years of non-internship professional software development
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability, scaling)
1+ years as a software development engineer or in a related occupation
1+ years building large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software in C#, C++, Java or Perl
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
nice: 3+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations
details.benefits: Base salary $143,700 – $194,400 a year (Austin, TX). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Export control: candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
